import json, urllib.request, hashlib
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/"
def request(url, method="GET"):
    r=urllib.request.Request(url,method=method,headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-V23-Release-Verification/1.0","Cache-Control":"no-cache"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=12) as response:
        body=response.read(16385) if method=="GET" else b""
        assert response.status==200,(url,response.status)
        return json.loads(body) if method=="GET" else {"size":int(response.headers.get("Content-Length","0")),"type":response.headers.get("Content-Type","")}
a=request(root+"native/latest.json")
native=json.loads(a["payload"])
assert native["version_code"]==23 and native["version_name"]=="0.3.2-ota"
assert native["sha256"]=="52724b9eb739dec366b9f1713de89acec5d4b50e6a0bf730b63269088482d501"
apk=request(root+"native/"+native["file"],"HEAD")
assert apk["size"]==native["size"] and apk["size"]==55012038,apk
u=request(root+"latest.json")
ota=json.loads(u["payload"])
assert ota["revision"]==19 and ota["sha256"]=="840416af2dfa7b4bd6bfe80f38e2fc75a00c5bcaf67e85f135f967141e82d21e"
html=request(root+ota["file"],"HEAD")
assert html["size"]==ota["size"],html
print(json.dumps({"status":"public_verified","apk_version":native["version_code"],"apk_http":200,"apk_bytes":apk["size"],"ota_revision":ota["revision"],"ota_http":200,"html_http":200,"app_url":"https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/native/latest.json"}))
